name: sandy
description: Sandy — SANDBOXable AI assistant. MCP-only, VPN-safe, audit-logged.

scripts.conformance: npm run test:conformance && npm run conformance:docker && npm run conformance:sandbox
scripts.conformance:docker:standalone: npm run build && SANDY_MODE=standalone bash conformance/run-docker.sh
scripts.conformance:sandbox:docker: npm run build && SANDY_MATRIX=docker bash conformance/sandbox-matrix.sh
scripts.conformance:sandbox:firejail: npm run build && SANDY_MATRIX=firejail bash conformance/sandbox-matrix.sh
scripts.conformance:sandbox:standalone: npm run build && SANDY_MODE=standalone bash conformance/sandbox-matrix.sh
